pick.name: Inoreader (Free)
pick.what: Web + Android RSS reader with folders, search and newsletter feeds
pick.why: Most generous mainstream free tier (150 feeds, unlimited folders) with web and Android apps; enough for the radar routine
pick.free_limits: Free: 150 feeds, 20 newsletter + 20 web feeds, ads; rules/filters/AI are Pro ($7.50/mo annual)

alts.name: Miniflux (hosted)
alts.what: Minimal, fast open-source reader with a clean REST API
alts.why: Best pay-later/hackable pick: $15/yr hosted or free self-hosted; Claude Code can pull unread items via the API to write your weekly digest
alts.free_limits: Hosted $15/yr (15-day trial); unread kept 60 days, starred forever; self-host free

candidates.name: Fluent Reader
candidates.verdict: Windows OSS desktop reader (v1.3.1 2026-10-15); no phone sync on its own

decision: Inoreader Free covers ~150 feeds across laptop and phone at $0. Switch to Miniflux ($15/yr) when you want Claude Code to read your feeds through an API and write the weekly digest automatically.
details: Feed GitHub releases.atom, YouTube channel feeds and newsletters into the same reader.

verify.note: Inoreader official: Free 150 feeds, Pro $7.50/mo annual ($9.99 monthly), Pro 2,500 feeds.
